question: Do you have sourdough loaves today, how much are they, and can I reserve one?
transcript:
Agent: Do you have sourdough loaves today? How much are they? Can I reserve one?
Seller: Yes, the sourdough loaves are in stock. A sourdough loaf is $8. We baked 12 loaves this morning. You can pick it up any time today. I can reserve one under your name.

availability.evidence: Yes, the sourdough loaves are in stock.

delivery_or_pickup.evidence: You can pick it up any time today.

contact_next_step.evidence: I can reserve one under your name.
